name: whendowe
description: One canonical event, projected into many calendars — with attribution.

scripts.check: biome check . && npm run typecheck && vitest run --coverage --project unit --project property --project contract && vitest run --project workers
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p deploy/cloudflare/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/workers/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:worker: rm -rf dist/worker && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c deploy/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --outdir "$PWD/dist/worker/bundle" && rm dist/worker/bundle/README.md && mkdir dist/worker/migrations && cp migrations/*.sql dist/worker/migrations/ && cp deploy/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc dist/worker/wrangler.template.jsonc
